text:
If you've got evening plans outdoors, keep half an eye on the sky through around 8 or 10 tonight, that's the window forecasters say still holds a chance of a shower or rumble of thunder before things start to quiet down. It's mild out there, upper 50s by the overnight low, with a light south wind. The lake's still churned up some, with waves 1 to 3 feet and showers likely through the evening, so if you're near the water tonight, don't plan on it being calm.

Monday looks like a step in the right direction, mostly sunny for a good chunk of the day, high near 76, though the forecasters and the models don't fully agree on how wet it stays. NWS has a 40 percent chance of a midday and afternoon shower or storm, and the Euro is notably wetter than the American model on this one, so I'd keep a rain plan in your back pocket even under sunshine. Good waterfront morning, but I'd watch the western sky by early afternoon.
